title: Unit contraction and target-chain telescope comparison
statement: For the target-chain inclusion i and retraction r of the enlarged bar [def-sc-compact-flat-bar-target-retraction], the composite r;i is homotopic to identity on the full bar. The canonical augmentation of the target-chain bar into the supplied telescope [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map] is an isomorphism in the homotopy category.
